main body: A fenced crop field: a large plot of wheat, cabbages and seedling rows enclosed by wooden post-and-rail fences on all four sides
top_band: none. A column through the middle runs from the top fence rail (tan rail with a dark post gap) into golden wheat, green rows, cabbages and soil. The field is a flat plan with no top band over a front face.
evidence: The farm is mostly a plan view of crop rows seen from above, filling the interior with no vertical front face. The fence sides are drawn as flat strips. The rails are front-on bands with no distinct top surface and no front-edge line or eave shadow. It is not an open frame or rack with beams and a base showing top faces, so the kind label does not fit and the 3/4 contract is not met.

style.evidence: The wheat has speckled highlights in 4-5 yellows and browns. The cabbages have 4-5 green steps with dark green undersides. The soil rows carry grain and the wooden rails have 4 tones. Outlines are dark brown beside wood and dark green beside leaves, not near-black. No large flat fills, and per-tile colour counts are high, comparable to the reference stall and well.
